name: Cook for Twelve
description: Turn two to four recipes with different serving sizes and units (cups, ounces, pounds, pints, tablespoons) into the cheapest shopping basket: scale, convert, merge, take off the cupboard, then buy whole packs with multibuy offers. The basket is checked for every ingredient and compared with the cheapest basket found by trying every combination.
hook: Scale the recipes, convert the cups, and spend as little as possible.
author: Gauntlet Real-World Pack
